headline: A new version of Wyrm
author: OM Rajput
releaseNotes: Wyrm Update — Android 8.5.9 / iOS 2.4.6
APPEARANCE
• Added new themes and restored all 8 classic Wyrm themes.
• Softer accents, cleaner cards and reduced heavy shadows.
• Improved lobby readability, rounded corners and Play buttons.
• Grape Ice Dark becomes the default once after updating; later choices remain saved.
CONTROLS
• Added an Arrow “Double tap to boost” toggle.
• Fixed returning-finger steering: boost continues on the held finger, while a returning steering finger regains control.
• Improved boost-button handling and joystick touch ownership.
• Fixed joysticks accept steering across their side of the screen.
• Wyrm joystick appearance stays consistent while pressed and released.
• Classic Assist laser follows the steering touch.
ARENA & TEXT
• Improved original-style text rendering across names, leaderboard, stats, key labels, chat and player roster.
• Continuous snake-name size slider with a real snake preview.
• Smooth leaderboard size adjustment and improved layout-editor positioning.
• Separate chat text-size control for TEAM, GLOBAL and ONLINE.
• Corrected oversized zoom symbols and Near Original server labels.
• All food textures use one size control and scale with the snake when zooming.
SKINS & iOS
• Restored Saved skins long-press Edit / Remove actions.
• Fixed iOS Rain panel drag geometry checks.
• Improved landscape rotation and keyboard handling.
